subject: Re: Temporary retention extension & coordinated purge schedule for upcoming audit
messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmehealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary retention extension request for audit

Hi Soojin,

We're kicking off a compliance audit with our regulators the week of July 20 and need to ensure certain logs and backup snapshots covering Q1–Q2 are retained for an additional 60 days beyond the standard retention window. Specific asks:
- Extend immutable snapshot retention for the project "patient-sync" by 60 days (estimated 450 GB).
- Hold of any purge operations on daily logs for the period July 18–Aug 30 for a targeted review.
- A list of current subprocessors that might have copies of archived logs (we requested the CSV but need confirmation).

Attached is the auditor request (Audit_Request_AcmeHealth.pdf). Can you confirm whether Redwood can accommodate a temporary grace interval and what the impact to the scheduled backup purge will be? Also please confirm if an addendum to our DPA is required for the extension.

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Doe
Head of Compliance
Acme Health

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmehealth.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary retention extension request for audit

Hi Jane — thanks for the details and the PDF. Short answer: yes, we can support a temporary retention extension for the "patient-sync" snapshots and pause purges for the specified log window, but I need to coordinate with Legal and Operations for the exact timeline and any DPA addendum.

Next steps from our side:
1) Internal review (legal/ops) to confirm whether a formal amendment is required for the 60-day extension.
2) Ops to surface any subprocessor implications (copies stored by S3 backup provider or analytics vendor).
3) We'll prepare a short mutual action plan and a proposed addendum draft if Legal deems it necessary.

I copied our lead on retention and legal — Kimberly and Marissa — and will follow up internally. I'll schedule a 30-min sync if that's helpful.

Best,
Sooyin Lee

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Temporary retention extension request for audit

Team — FYI: Acme Health (deal ACME-3721) needs a 60-day retention extension for the "patient-sync" snapshots and a purge hold on daily logs July 18–Aug 30. They attached the auditor request. Key constraints:
- Storage delta ~450 GB for snapshot extension.
- Need to confirm subprocessors that may have archived copies (they asked for CSV — I attached the latest we have).
- They ask whether a DPA addendum is required.

Can you advise:
- Kimberly: will Legal require an addendum for a temporary, time-limited retention change? Is an emergency carveout ok or do we need exec approval?
- Marissa: operationally, can Ops mark the project to exclude from purge and extend immutable snapshot TTLs? Any downstream chargebacks?
- Karthik: any privacy/regulatory concerns for cross-border copies — Acme's auditors may request evidence if backups pass through APAC subprocessors.

Attach: Subprocessor_List_20260630.csv, Audit_Request_AcmeHealth.pdf

Thanks — Soojin

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Temporary retention extension request for audit

Soojin — quick read: a time-bounded retention extension like this is typically handled via an addendum to the DPA that describes the specific data sets, timeframe, and compensation (if any). We can use a short-form addendum (2–3 clauses) that:
- Defines the exceptional retention window (2026-07-18 through 2026-08-30).
- Confirms scope: snapshot identifiers / project name ("patient-sync") and log namespaces; excludes unrelated services.
- States that Redwood remains the controller/processor arrangement unchanged and that subprocessors remain bound by existing obligations.
- Requires Acme to confirm auditor access rules and whether Redwood should provide a read-only evidence package.

I don't expect exec sign-off for a 60-day, low-storage delta unless there are political discounts. We should propose a nominal operational fee for the storage delta and the evidence package (we can push this in the MAP).

I'll draft Proposed_Addendum_v2.docx and route for quick review. Karthik — please flag if any cross-border proof or subprocessor disclosures need to be enhanced.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Temporary retention extension request for audit

We can implement the hold and extend immutable snapshot TTLs for "patient-sync". Notes for Ops runbook:
- Snapshot extension: change TTL from 90d -> 150d for snapshot IDs matching patient-sync tags; delta storage ~0.45 TB (estimated).
- Purge hold: set exclusion flag on daily-log-{patient-sync}-* between 2026-07-18 and 2026-08-30; ensure backfill does not auto-trigger cleanup after hold lifts for 48 hours to allow evidence export.
- Subprocessor impact: S3 backup provider (CloudPartner) will need a temporary hold on lifecycle rules; we will send their contacts a signed work order to suspend purge.
- Cost estimate: ops + storage + evidence packaging ~USD 1,250 one-time; optional ongoing per-GB charges if extension increases beyond 60 days.

I'll coordinate with CloudPartner (cc'd earlier in my sync) — Soojin, if Acme accepts we should get DocuSign and CloudPartner acknowledgement before 7/15 to meet timelines.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Program Manager, Customer Ops
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmehealth.com>

Soojin — thanks to you and the team for the quick turnaround. Acme confirms we accept the proposed 60-day extension and the operational fee. We also confirm that the addendum scope should be limited to the "patient-sync" snapshots and associated daily logs only. Please go ahead with the Short Addendum (Proposed_Addendum_v2.docx) and share the DocuSign link.

Action items we expect from Redwood before July 22:
- Signed DPA addendum via DocuSign.
- Confirmation from CloudPartner that lifecycle rules for the affected backups are suspended for the window (we copied them).
- A short evidence package template describing data ranges and snapshots you will hold.

Thanks — Jane
